scrutiny.test: T0 purpose: docs/IDEA.md makes prismis an unattended pipeline agents query; a title-only decision that records why turns failure analysis into one query and lets the model catch junk the rules miss.
scrutiny.failureCase: The change were neutral on what reaches analysis or on knowing why.

scrutiny.test: T1 owners: constitution.md:49 (success, empty and failure never share a representation) and :55 (unattended behavior records what it decided and why) are what the design implements; boundaries.md:55 is extended, boundaries.md:50 (ten kinds) untouched.
scrutiny.failureCase: An owner forbade a model input to the title-only decision.

scrutiny.test: T6 assumptions: trafilatura's `fetch_response` returns a Response with `.status` when a response arrives and None when the request failed outright (read in the installed trafilatura.downloads); the light model returned a boolean `substantive` for all 101 probe items on cerebro.
scrutiny.failureCase: The fetch status or the model field were not actually available.

scrutiny.test: T7 writers of title_only, enumerated with grep over daemon/src and cli/src: analysis.py:84 (build_llm_analysis) and refetch.py:238, which patches `title_only = True` onto a still-unreadable row with no LLM call. The design decides title-only only in build_llm_analysis and leaves the refetch patch writing a flag with no reason. Revised: one helper, `title_only_reason` in analysis.py, produces the reason for both writers; refetch's patch stores title_only and title_only_reason from it.
scrutiny.failureCase: A second title-only writer stored the flag without a reason.

scrutiny.test: T3 degrades: a real short post the model misjudges becomes title-only (0 of 50 readable items in the probe); the TUI and web do not print the reason.
scrutiny.failureCase: A degradation were offered as an option.

scrutiny.test: T4 reuse: the orchestrator merge already carries fetcher keys into storage (orchestrator.py:697); the existing summarize call gains one field; `is_readable` keeps its contract.
scrutiny.failureCase: A second LLM call or a second store path were added.

scrutiny.test: T5 real-system proof: after deploy, group new items' `analysis.title_only_reason` on cerebro and read a sample of each reason against its content.
T10 undo: revert the commit; the new keys are additive and nothing is migrated.

T11 class: unattended decisions that drop their reason, swept across every extraction path (`grep -rn 'extract_article(\|_extract_transcript(' daemon/src`): RSS fallback, Reddit article, YouTube transcript and refetch all record an outcome in the design.
scrutiny.failureCase: A sibling extraction path kept collapsing its failure into None.

scrutiny.test: Re-check of the revised form: the only title_only writers left are the helper's two callers (build_llm_analysis, refetch's patch); `fetch_response`'s None and `.status` give the three fetch outcomes their distinct detail.
scrutiny.failureCase: A writer still stored title_only without the helper.
